column4: Brief called it memory-only; checked section by section: findings 1.1-1.9, rejected 'modernise the staging', IIIS check (Nakata 2025), Fix 1 min-bout with the raw/smoothed split, the four IIIS items, Fix 4 Otsu sweep (D2 23.0-88.9, 65.9 pts), kappa harness and packs, Japanese tool read-off, fixes 3/5/6/9/10, closing state are all in that note. The 100-iteration cap and the nm-shadowing bug are in journal 2026-08-08; decision rules and the r@1min rule in blind-scoring-and-kappa; tool algorithm in sleepyscore-japan-scoring-tool-algorithm; positive control in positive-control-known-signal-injection. Nothing promoted.

Facts are in journals 2026-07-15, 2026-07-16, 2026-07-18 and 2026-07-15-earth-and-sleep-council; Allego gotchas belong to the allego area. Its 'Scripts in vault 02-procedures/...' and 'Not yet under git' lines are stale. Suggested retarget for [[eeg-qc-tooling]]: scripts-archive-pre-sleep64-readme.

Test, archive-scale numbers (SCOREABLE 44 -> 69, shuffle 0/100, mains 68 %, dark>light 47/49) and 'not adopted' are in that note and 2026-10-02-noise-series-method-audit; the 10-06 mains-free measure (kappa 0.95) is in 2026-10-06-S-SD-EMG-rescue-between-harmonics. Only the NpzDict stand-in gotcha is not in the vault; it is a code detail visible in qc/emg_mains_staging_test.py. Hub Current state carries both.

Memory says the two regression suites skip and exit 0; code since c5bbd55 (2026-09-26) exits 2 'VERIFIED NOTHING', confirmed by running both on 2026-10-22 (contradiction EA-1, settled). New note holds how to run the suites, which verify nothing and why (fixtures only in S3), ~/eeg-test-venv, pytest coverage. Retarget slug -> analysis-test-suites.

Pre-registration, 112 floor channels, criterion, 262-channel XDAT layout, interim 1.66 h result and falsification are in that note; hardware band-pass 1.10-475.17 Hz in 2026-08-07-rig-specification-and-analysis-method and radiens-software-reference; filtered-floor 69 uV and spectral-shape method in the rig-specification note and journal 2026-08-06. Script it names was deleted 2026-08-11 (2026-08-11-analysis-stack-consolidation).

Stages, filename law, EDF 6389.56 range, threshold re-derivation (RAIL, OPEN 150, FLAT_UV 11 / DEAD_CHANNEL_UV 20, CLIP_FRAC) are in eeg-pipeline-manual; framing (record wideband, offline filtering is standard; r@1min is ours) in analysis-methods-and-justification and journal 2026-08-03. Its vault path 02-procedures/eeg-data-analysis/pipeline/ is stale. Suggested retarget for [[eeg-analysis-pipeline]]: eeg-pipeline-manual.

Vault and code say the signals are bipolar on the chip (CANONICAL-allego-channel-selection) and that half of the repo was deleted 2026-08-11 (D1); core/config.py, core/channel_map.py and sleep/ are absent on 2026-10-22. Settled against the memory (EA-13). The MA1..MD2 naming convention is in no vault note; current names are port{P}-slot{S} (eeg-pipeline-manual).

No journal for 2026-08-26 and no vault note on the fix. Per-chip range on uid0825 differs from the code comment (EA-9, open). Retarget slug -> 2026-08-26-per-chip-floor-fix.

Same name as the vault incident note, which holds the mechanism, 11 of 79 cards, fix a52133c + 2cc5892, the two rejected detectors and open hum-route item. EMG gate results, absolute-delta falsification (C1/C2 withdrawn), per-chip null, how far back the pooled floor reaches and the B2 re-run are in that note; pooled-floor table also in the old hub notice (now in eeg-analysis-quickstart) and animal-card-and-verdict-ladder; literature check in is-our-qc-approach-sound.
